history.name: Generating the documents
history.description: `ledger build` writes the documents and the client's edition, together or one at a time, into the project's output directory or anywhere else asked for. It is run by hand, when someone needs a fresh copy and always when a release is presented — the record is the thing that's kept, and the documents are made from it on demand.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/build.mjs — cmdBuild; --md / --pdf select, --out overrides the directory. Shape rules are enforced here as errors, so a badly shaped record can't be printed.

history.description: `ledger build` writes the documents and the client's edition, together or one at a time, into the project's output directory or anywhere else asked for. With no version asked for it prints the newest edition that has something in it — straight after a release is closed that is the release just closed, not the empty one it opened — so closing a release and building is all it takes to mint the edition for what was just presented. It is run by hand, when someone needs a fresh copy and always when a release is presented — the record is the thing that's kept, and the documents are made from it on demand.
changes: It used to print whichever release was open, which meant the first build after closing one produced an edition for a release with nothing in it yet — a copy of the one just presented, numbered as if it were the next. The document wanted at that moment is always the one just closed, so that is now what an unqualified build prints; the open release still prints on request, marked as a draft.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/build.mjs — cmdBuild; --md / --pdf select, --out overrides the directory, --version N|all overrides which edition. The default is project.editionVersion in src/store.mjs: the last version anything was recorded against, so an open release with nothing in it falls back to its predecessor. Shape rules are enforced here as errors, so a badly shaped record can't be printed.
